تعتنقوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَنِقُوا (taʕtaniqū) /taʕ.ta.ni.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# تُعْتَنَقُوا (tuʕtanaqū) /tuʕ.ta.na.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
